claims: Ripple Treasury introduced 24/7 Returns for eligible corporate customers
eligible customers may earn returns on qualifying digital assets held in Ripple wallets, including RLUSD, subject to program requirements
the broader Treasury platform combines treasury management, AI-powered orchestration, payments and digital rails
limitations: no program AUM, RLUSD balance, yield or customer-level adoption data disclosed
eligibility and program requirements limit generalization

claims: Ripple said it was on track to exit 2026 with $900M annualized product revenue
Ripple said its products enabled over $16T in transactions during 2025
Ripple reported more than 85 licenses, 1,700+ institutions/corporates/enterprises, 60+ payout markets and network lifetime volume approaching $150B by year end
Ripple reported 3x growth in customers and partners using multiple solutions
Ripple reported RLUSD market capitalization around $2.6B and availability on Coinbase, Robinhood, Binance, Kraken and OKX
Ripple said RLUSD facilitates onchain repo markets
Ripple described Ripple Prime as providing cross-margining, financing and clearing across traditional and digital venues
Ripple announced BNY collaboration to advance tokenized trade finance on XRPL, beginning with a supplier-finance initiative with C2FO
Ripple said Privy supports programmable-wallet payments with XRP, RLUSD and other digital assets on XRPL, including AI-agent use cases
Ripple Treasury's 24/7 Returns combines RLUSD, tokenized money-market funds on XRPL and institutional liquidity infrastructure
limitations: all scale metrics are company-reported and span multiple Ripple products
$16T transactions enabled in 2025 is not XRP-specific volume
RLUSD repo use does not prove XRP is collateral in Ripple Prime
tokenized money-market funds on XRPL do not necessarily use XRP as the asset or collateral
BNY/C2FO supplier-finance initiative is not quantified
Privy support does not establish production payment volume

claims: RLUSD launched on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail across XRPL, Base and Ethereum
Ripple says it will provide liquidity on Base
Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was a future rollout
limitations: no independent volume or collateral utilization disclosed
Global Exchange collateral feature was not live at announcement
